scope: Prospective, deliberately targeted synthetic binding stress suite. Not representative retrieval, BEAM confirmation, field extraction or memory quality.

policy.scope: Prospective, deliberately targeted synthetic binding stress suite. Not representative retrieval, BEAM confirmation, field extraction or memory quality.
policy.program: Reuse frozen V5 writer/Jev prompts, source eligibility, candidate spans, exact grammar, typed recommendation program and rendering. The guarded arm only vetoes exact identity mismatches from the same authenticated supported semantic decisions.
policy.caseDesign: 20 newly authored cases: 4 structured canonical controls, 8 new paraphrase-template families and 8 new adversarial/boundary families. New identities alone do not make a new semantic family. Independent source/gold review precedes every provider call.
policy.goldIsolation: Source-only candidate construction; gold separate and unavailable to request construction. Root and runner are not shown new case prose before code freeze. Any fixture correction occurs before the final freeze and any paid request.
policy.semanticAdmission: Only the selected supported choice admits; no new threshold, confidence tuning, additional model call, or guard-only admission. Exact-match and unrecognized never create a binding.
policy.primaryDecision: Finite cleanup demonstrated only if the veto removes at least one gold-unsupported admission, removes zero gold-supported admissions, and preserves or improves the number of correct complete recommendations versus the same unguarded semantic draws. If no false admission is removed, no cleanup benefit is demonstrated. This is not a utility or superiority gate.
policy.reporting: Report all-case TP/FP/FN/TN, admission precision/recall, supported emitted fields and field precision, correct complete recommendation coverage and absolute counts, missingness, conflicts, malformed answers, whole-case outcome accuracy, each group, timing and total cost. Zero-denominator precision/recall is null, never one.
policy.writerComparison: Emitted-field precision and correct complete recommendation coverage are a descriptive pair; whole-case outcome accuracy is supplementary. No isolated Jev-versus-writer causal claim, since answer construction also differs.
policy.inference: A complete finite stress suite with one draw per distinct request. No optional stopping, resampling to clear a threshold, or representative-population confidence claim. Preserve every failure. Source/gold ambiguity found after freeze invalidates the affected interpretation without silently dropping the case.
policy.predecessor: Closed independently audited V6 confirmation, 396 Gateway records and 673 settled Jev calls. Preserve the complete native prefix, four closed semantic ledgers and the two historical uncertain Gateway reservations. Add this version's binding ledger exactly once.
policy.promotion: No production activation, language extension, baseline replacement or BEAM-confirmation promotion. V6's failed confirmation verdict remains immutable regardless of this outcome.

cleanup.interpretation: Finite cleanup only; not a usefulness, writer-superiority, generalization or promotion gate.

jev.interpretation: Captured request service times; sums are not end-to-end wall latency.

writer.interpretation: Captured request service times; sums are not end-to-end wall latency.

limitations: Twenty deliberately targeted authored cases are a finite mechanism test, not representative memory, retrieval or field-extraction evidence.

The g03 control treats canonically equivalent composed/decomposed Unicode title strings as distinct identifiers under the fixture's exact-string policy. The prompts request exact identity but do not explicitly specify Unicode normalization; cleanup on this control does not establish semantic misunderstanding or better general factual quality.

Every arm is restricted to supplied eligible candidates. In g10 the source names the title but no title candidate is supplied; withholding it tests inventory obedience, not an inability to recover that title by reading the source.
Both semantic programs use the same captured decisions; the veto only removes exact identity mismatches and does not verify unrecognized prose.
Writer comparison changes the answer-construction bundle. Field support precision and correct complete recommendation coverage are distinct from status accuracy.
Host-supplied source authority, candidate spans and locked item identities remain assumptions. Source hashes and replay do not prove semantic entailment or world truth.
One draw per distinct request; no population confidence or automatic promotion claim. Gateway writer identity is an alias, not a verified immutable snapshot.
V6's failed confirmation verdict and all preceding exposure, including uncertain reservations, remain unchanged.
